# Release Tracking

Use these sources for recency, version drift, and recent behavior changes.

## Primary URLs
- Nightly builds: https://odin-lang.org/docs/nightly/
- News and articles: https://odin-lang.org/news
- GitHub tagged releases: https://github.com/odin-lang/Odin/releases

## How to Use Them
- Check the nightly page when a user asks about the latest available compiler builds or very recent changes.
- Check the news page for newsletters, migration notes, and articles that explain major changes.
- Check GitHub tagged releases for stable release history and release artifacts.

## Verified Facts
- The nightly page publishes dated nightly builds and links to tagged releases.
- The news page includes newsletters and change-oriented articles such as platform support and API transition notes.
- The nightly page should be checked for its latest listed build date before making any recency claim.

## Caution
- Nightly behavior may differ from the latest stable release.
- State clearly whether an answer is based on stable docs, tagged releases, newsletters, or nightlies.
